notes.title: Introducing our new game - The Bookwalker: Thief of Tales
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We are excited to announce the release date of our new game, which we’ve been working on lately. 
[i][b]The Bookwalker: Thief of Tales[/b][/i] will be available on Steam on [b]June 22nd![/b] And you can play the new demo now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1432100/The_Bookwalker_Thief_of_Tales/ 

[h2]Watch the cinematic trailer[/h2]
[previewyoutube=sNGyCm8OTgI;full][/previewyoutube]

Etienne Quist is a writer-turned-thief with a unique ability to dive into the very pages of books. Once a celebrated writer, his creative freedom was stripped away when he was found guilty of an unspeakable crime. Now tasked by a criminal boss, Etienne must venture into mesmerizing book realms, seeking legendary artifacts to restore his creative abilities.

🕮 Step into the living pages of book worlds as The Bookwalker.
🌍 Explore unique worlds, each with its own mysteries to uncover.
🪄 Embark on daring artifact heists to reclaim your creative freedom.
🧩 Solve unconventional puzzles, wield the power of magical ink, and encounter intriguing characters whose stories hold the key to your journey.
💪 Face obstacles on your quest for artifacts. Be prepared to persuade, deceive, or even engage in combat.

Here the new game update:
